frames.phenology:
*Acer pseudoplatanus*: Full dense canopy, dark green with minor early browning and tar spot; mature winged samaras drying brown.
*Tilia × europaea*: Full foliage, dull green with slight yellowing and aphid sooty mould; cymes with pale bracts bearing hard nutlets.
*Ulmus glabra*: Full canopy, deep green, coarse texture; no fruits.
*Betula pendula*: Light pendulous canopy, bright green with initial yellowing on outer twigs; disintegrating female catkins shed seed.
*Lolium perenne*: Intact, green, vegetative.
*Poa pratensis*: Dense, green, mown vegetative turf.

*Tilia × europaea*: dense canopy, fading yellow-green with minor leaf drop, pale fruiting bracts visible.
*Ulmus glabra*: full canopy, deep green turning dull, no fruit.
*Betula pendula*: light canopy, green flecked with yellow, ripe catkins.
